summary: Operator rate page + Campspot 2027 quotes: $20-55 confirmed and explained - $20 is a dry-camping RV site (12 sites, no hookups, to 44 ft), $45 the full-hookup back-in/pull-through sites, $55 the 2 concrete-pad back-in sites (the only type over $50; no Good Sam, base well under the gate, no gateway within 40 km); $2 booking fee per stay confirmed. 50 A full hookups confirmed; max 60, pull-through added; showers + wifi added, laundry confirmed; booking url. Site count: no page states one (Campspot sells 9 full-hookup + 12 dry nightly), left unset. Long-stay tests pass: $45 FHU under $50, nightly rate + phone on its own site and one night on Campspot, no minimum, no count stated, not a home community (imagery shows many rigs that look parked long-term). Pond lead: a ~60 m farm pond in the open field 100+ m from the RV rows - 'not waterfront' stands. Pin at the entrance on the highway, ~160 m from the RV rows: fine. Note unchanged.
